title.suggested: Grand Opening of Tom Allen's Concert Hall

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican carried a notice that Tom Allen's new concert hall at 417 Washington Avenue would open Saturday, March 4, with concerts every Saturday, Sunday and Monday evening at 7 o'clock.

metadata.notes: masthead reads THE MISSOURI REPUBLICAN--ST. LOUIS, MARCH 3, 1871

facts.fact: Allen opened a new concert hall at 417 Washington Avenue, St. Louis, with concerts every Saturday, Sunday and Monday evening
